title: The Birthday Party
text:
Maria got a letter last week. It was an invitation to a birthday party for her friend Lucia. The party was on Saturday at four o'clock in the afternoon. Maria wanted to go to the party.

Maria bought a small gift for Lucia. She wrote a card, too. On Saturday, Maria went to Lucia's house with her gift. Lucia was very happy to see her.

questions.text: What did Maria buy for Lucia?
How does Maria feel about the invitation?
Why was Lucia happy to see Maria?
options: Maria was her friend and came to her party

vocabulary.definition: a card or letter that asks someone to come to an event
something you give to someone, often on a special day
the part of the day between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: María recibió una carta la semana pasada. Era una invitación a la fiesta de cumpleaños de su amiga Lucía. La fiesta fue el sábado a las cuatro de la tarde. María quería ir a la fiesta.
María compró un regalo pequeño para Lucía. También escribió una tarjeta. El sábado, María fue a la casa de Lucía con su regalo. Lucía estaba muy feliz de verla.
